title: pyrus lanuginosa
intro: Pyrus lanuginosa, commonly known as Downy Pear, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, cough, and respiratory issues due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Pyrus lanuginosa include its use as an antimicrobial agent and a treatment for digestive issues, while its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the effects and potential applications of this plant.
